summary: asciinema is a web application designed for hosting and sharing terminal session recordings, known as asciicasts. It allows you to publish text-based command-line interactions so they can be viewed and played back inside a web browser.
goodFor: It is a good fit if you need a private platform to host and share terminal recordings within your own infrastructure without relying on external services.
watchOut: You should note that managing a self-hosted instance of this niche media platform requires maintaining an Elixir runtime stack and handling ongoing updates.
deployNotes: Deployment typically involves running the application via Docker behind a reverse proxy for TLS termination, alongside provisioning a persistent database for stored records.
